sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/357 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 357, search/grid facility 481 'John Bryan Campground' for 2027-06-15, 2026-12-08 and 2027-01-12, search/details for every unit on 2027-06-15, plus sites 11 and 01 on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: RV sites are the electric sites: $37 a night, the same on a Saturday (June 2027); $33 off-peak (November 2026, January 2027). The 19 non-electric sites ($27, $23 off-peak) are typed tent sites (not RV sites) with no pad length or driveway, so they don't set the RV base. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all John Bryan campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 37.00, IsRVSite true; Campsite Non-Electric 27.00, IsRVSite false, IsTentSite true, PullInType 'Not Applicable', no Pad Length; grid MapInfo UnitImage 'Ohio/Units/tent' for the 19); sites 11 and 01 on Sat 2027-06-19 (37.00 / 27.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (33.00 / 23.00), Fee 6.50, read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (24 of the 31 electric sites list Electricity Hookup '50' or '20/30/50'; 7 leave it blank; no water or sewer hookup listed) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/john-bryan-state-park-campground ('32 electric and 20 non-electric sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 31 web-bookable electric RV sites with pad lengths 35-51 ft (14 at 35 ft, most of the rest 40-45), one pull-through (40 ft); plus 19 non-electric tent sites. ODNR counts 32 electric and 20 non-electric sites. Four group camps take no RVs. Pets permitted on all sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid 481 (50 units) + search/details (Campsite Electric: IsRVSite true, Pad Length 35-51, PullInTypeName 'Back In' x30 / 'Pull Through' x1) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/john-bryan-state-park-campground ('52 electric and non-electric sites', 'Pets are permitted on all sites', group camps 'No RVs allowed'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Renovated camp store (937-767-1274) sells firewood, ice and supplies. Potable water stays on in the off-season.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/john-bryan-state-park-campground ('Shower house, drinking water, and a dump station are available'; 'A newly renovated camp store (937-767-1274) offers firewood, ice, and other supplies'; 'Potable water is available during off season'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak November 1 to April 1: shower house, dump station and all sites stay available; group camps closed.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/john-bryan-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season: From November 1 to April 1. Shower house, dump station, and all sites available. Group camps closed Nov - April') + ReserveOhio search/grid 481 for 2027-01-12 (all 50 units free), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations can be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' Every campsite is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

summary: Fees changed: base 27 -> 37 (the $27 non-electric sites are ReserveOhio tent sites, IsRVSite false, no pad), electric surcharge cleared, added $33 off-peak. Added 50-amp electric, 31 RV sites with pads to 51 ft and one pull-through, showers/water/dump/camp store, year-round, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max. Pin 92 m from the sites' centroid (fine). Not stated for this campground: walk-ins and the weekend minimum (left inherited). Shelter/day-lodge renovations (Sept 2026) don't touch the campground.
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground and park pages give (937) 767-1274 (park office; the campground page lists the camp store at the same number).
